title: Demo farm: folding or unfolding a demo does not interrupt the other folded demos (two web slots, health-gated forwarders)
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/demo-farm.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/demo-farm-callers.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/farm-monitoring.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of the switch, forwarder-config, compose-slot, entrypoint and monitoring cases named in run.tests.
expect: farm_switch starts the next slot and marks it ready before the old one is withdrawn, waits tracy_farm_up_wait before withdrawing it, and a slot that never gets healthy is removed with the serving one left untouched.
An interrupted switch leaves a second web that the next settle withdraws (when ready), waits for, stops and only then removes; the serving slot keeps serving.
The forwarder config sends a new connection only to a farm web that answers ready on /tracy-ready.
server-status-alert.sh alerts when every running slot is unready, and not when one is ready.
evidence: 14/11/2026 e2e (test/e2e/demo-farm/run.sh, 3 rounds): through a current-config forwarder 0 failed in every fold, unfold, re-fold, image-tag refresh and farm-switch phase (~51-57k requests each); before the up-wait fix an unfold failed 93/49,896 and 57/51,674; the probe self-test counts a docker kill (5,793/14,363).
fence: Unit cases with a stateful fake docker; the e2e (rootless Docker) is the end-to-end proof and is not part of this case's run.

tests: forwarder config: a new connection goes only to a farm web that answers ready, and a slot is out before it stops
farm compose: two web slots with the same alias, one hash; the database is rendered once
farm compose: the web drains on stop — a grace period that outlasts Apache and FPM, and Apache drain is bounded
farm entrypoint: TERM, INT and QUIT drain Apache (WINCH) first, then php-fpm (QUIT); a crash still ends the farm
farm_switch: the next slot starts and is ready BEFORE the old one leaves its forwarders; then drain, stop, remove
farm_switch: a pre-slot farm (one container named tracy-demos-web) is replaced by slot a, with no marker to take away
farm_switch: a new slot that never gets healthy is removed and the serving one is left exactly as it was
farm_switch: the forwarders get time to start using the new slot BEFORE the old one is withdrawn

settle after an interrupted switch (cut after the new slot was marked ready, .active-web not yet written): tracy-demos-web-b is withdrawn, waited for, stopped, removed; tracy-demos-web-a keeps serving
settle after an interrupted switch (cut after .active-web changed, the old slot not yet unready): tracy-demos-web-a is withdrawn, waited for, stopped, removed; tracy-demos-web-b keeps serving
settle after an interrupted switch (cut after the old slot was made unready, before it stopped): tracy-demos-web-a is withdrawn, waited for, stopped, removed; tracy-demos-web-b keeps serving
settle after an interrupted switch (cut while the new slot started, never ready): tracy-demos-web-b is withdrawn, waited for, stopped, removed; tracy-demos-web-a keeps serving
check-server.sh 7c: a ready slot is the one whose FPM is pinged, and the ping is not asked of an unready one
server-status-alert.sh: running slots that are all unready are an alert — no folded demo has a backend
server-status-alert.sh: a ready slot is no alert
